options: My brother plays basketball every Saturday.
My brother play basketball every Saturday.
My brother is play basketball every Saturday.
My brother playing basketball every Saturday.
answer: My brother plays basketball every Saturday.

wrong.My brother play basketball every Saturda: my brother 是第三人稱單數，現在式動詞要加 s，應為 plays。
wrong.My brother is play basketball every Satu: is 和 play 不能放在一起當動詞；習慣用現在簡單式 plays。
wrong.My brother playing basketball every Satu: playing 前面少了 is，而且 every Saturday 表示習慣，要用 plays。

why: every Saturday 表示習慣，用現在簡單式；主詞是單數的 my brother，所以動詞加 s。
tip: he、she、it 或單數名詞當主詞，動詞加 s。
say: My brother plays basketball every Saturday.

text: Look! The baby _____ in the garden right now.

wrong.cries: cries 是現在簡單式，right now 與 Look 表示正在發生，要用進行式。
wrong.cried: cried 是過去式，但句子說的是現在這一刻。
wrong.will cry: will cry 是未來，不符合 right now 的情境。

why: Look! 和 right now 都表示動作正在進行，要用現在進行式 is crying。
tip: Look! 和 right now 是現在進行式的線索。
say: The baby is crying in the garden right now.

prompt: 你想告訴老師：「我昨天去了圖書館。」哪句最正確？
options: I went to the library yesterday.
I go to the library yesterday.
I am going to the library yesterday.
I will went to the library yesterday.
answer: I went to the library yesterday.

yesterday 表示過去，go 是現在式，要改成 went。
am going 是現在進行或未來，不能和 yesterday 一起用。
will 後面要接原形，went 是過去式，而且 will 表示未來。

why: yesterday 是過去的時間，動詞用過去式 went。
tip: yesterday 搭配過去式，go 的過去式是 went。
say: I went to the library yesterday.

options: 水在攝氏一百度會沸騰
answer: 水在攝氏一百度會沸騰

wrong.水剛剛沸騰了: boils 是現在簡單式，不是過去式 boiled。
wrong.水明天會沸騰: 句中沒有 will 或 tomorrow，不是未來。
wrong.水現在不會沸騰: 句子是一般事實，沒有否定。

why: 科學真理用現在簡單式，說的是一直都成立的事實。
tip: 科學事實，句子永遠用現在式。

prompt: 哪一句是正確的科學事實句？
options: The teacher said that the sun rises in the east.
The teacher said that the sun rose in the east.
The teacher said that the sun is rising in the east.
The teacher said that the sun will rise in the east.
answer: The teacher said that the sun rises in the east.

wrong.The teacher said that the sun rose in th: 雖然主要動詞是 said，但太陽東升是事實，仍然用現在式。
wrong.The teacher said that the sun is rising: 進行式表示正在發生，不是一般事實。
wrong.The teacher said that the sun will rise: will 表示未來，而這是一直成立的事實。

why: 即使主要子句用過去式，從屬子句若是科學事實，仍用現在簡單式。
tip: 事實真理永遠用現在式，不受 said 影響。
say: The sun rises in the east.

prompt: 你想說：「我明天要和朋友看電影。」哪句最適合？
options: I am going to watch a movie with my friend tomorrow.
I watched a movie with my friend tomorrow.
I watch a movie with my friend yesterday.
I was watching a movie with my friend tomorrow.
answer: I am going to watch a movie with my friend tomorrow.

wrong.I watched a movie with my friend tomorro: watched 是過去式，不能搭配 tomorrow。
wrong.I watch a movie with my friend yesterday: yesterday 是過去，但 watch 是現在式；時間也與題意相反。
wrong.I was watching a movie with my friend to: was watching 是過去進行式，不能配 tomorrow。

why: tomorrow 表示未來，可用 be going to + 原形動詞來表達計畫。
tip: tomorrow 表示未來，用 be going to 或 will。
say: I am going to watch a movie with my friend tomorrow.

text: Mom _____ dinner when I got home.

wrong.cooks: cooks 是現在式，但 got home 是過去的時間。
wrong.is cooking: is cooking 是現在進行，與過去情境不符。
wrong.will cook: will cook 是未來，不符合 when I got home 的過去情境。

why: when I got home 表示過去某一刻，媽媽當時正在煮飯，用過去進行式 was cooking。
tip: 過去某一刻正在做某事，用 was/were + V-ing。
say: Mom was cooking dinner when I got home.

prompt: 哪一句的句型是主詞加動詞加受詞？

is happy 是主詞加 be 動詞加補語，沒有受詞。
fast 是副詞修飾 runs，沒有受詞。
became tired 是主詞加連綴動詞加補語，沒有受詞。

why: kicked 後面接 the ball，ball 是被踢的對象，也就是受詞。
tip: 動詞後面接被作用的對象，就是受詞。

prompt: 朋友問：「你通常幾點起床？」哪句回答最自然？
options: I usually get up at six thirty.
I usually getting up at six thirty.
I usually got up in six thirty.
I am usually get up at six thirty.
answer: I usually get up at six thirty.

getting up 不能單獨當句子動詞，需要 get up。
usually 表示習慣，不用過去式；時間點用 at，不是 in。
am 與 get 重複當動詞，應直接說 I usually get up。

why: usually 表示習慣，用現在簡單式；具體時間點用 at。
tip: usually 搭配現在式；幾點鐘用 at。
say: I usually get up at six thirty.

text: I have already finished my homework, so I am free now.

wrong.作業還沒寫完: have already finished 表示已完成。
wrong.明天才要寫作業: 句中沒有未來時間，已經完成了。
wrong.不想寫作業: 句子沒說不想，只說已經完成。

why: have already finished 是現在完成式，表示已經完成，所以現在有空。
tip: already 通常搭配完成式，表示「已經」。
say: I have already finished my homework.

wrong.Do your sister like music?: your sister 是單數，要用 Does，不是 Do。
wrong.Does your sister likes music?: Does 已經帶有第三人稱 s，後面的動詞要用原形 like。
wrong.Is your sister like music?: Is 與 like 不能同時當動詞，一般動詞問句用 Does。

why: 第三人稱單數的一般動詞問句用 Does + 主詞 + 原形動詞。
tip: Does 後面接原形，不再加 s。
